function.name: get_current_time
function.description: Get the current date and time, optionally in a specific IANA time zone.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone name such as Europe/Copenhagen. Defaults to the user's local time zone.

function.name: get_weather
function.description: Get the current weather for a location.

location.description: City or place name, for example Copenhagen.

function.name: search_web
function.description: Search the web and return a short list of results.

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return. Defaults to 3.

function.name: create_reminder
function.description: Schedule a reminder a number of minutes from now.

delay_minutes.description: How many minutes from now the reminder should fire.
